name: Band Squat to Row
steps: Stand facing a waist-high band anchor with feet shoulder-width apart, gripping an end in each hand with extended arms under light tension.
Sit your hips back and down into a squat while keeping your arms straight and chest tall.
Drive smoothly upward to standing while pulling both elbows back past your ribs and squeezing your upper back.
Extend your arms back toward the anchor as you lower seamlessly into the next squat.
tips: Keep your heels grounded and spine neutral throughout the squat and pull.
Coordinate the row with standing upright rather than yanking the band with a rounded back.
